en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4740 - Ja'far ibn Bashir narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the children of polytheists who die before reaching the age of responsibility.
Imam (as) replied: "They are disbelievers, and Allah (swt) knows best what they would have done. They will enter the same places as their fathers."
